title: VERDE RESOURCES, INC.
text: EX-10.2 3 ex10-2.htm EX-10.2 Exhibit 10.2 SHARE COLLATERALIZATION AGREEMENT This Share Collateralization Agreement (the “Agreement”) is entered into as of __, 2026 (the “Effective Date”), by and between: PARTY A – SHAREHOLDER Name: Address: ________________________________ PARTY B – INVESTOR Name: __________________________________ Address: ________________________________ Party A and Party B may individually be referred to as a “Party” and collectively as the “Parties.” Party A is a director and the Chief Operating Officer of Verde Resources, Inc. (the “Company”). 1. PURPOSE OF AGREEMENT This Agreement is entered into in connection with a private placement investment made by Party B in the Company and in the form of shares of common stock of the Company, par value $0.001 per share (“Common Stock”) in the amount of $[-] (the “Investment”) pursuant to the Securities Purchase Agreement dated as of the date of this Agreement, by and between Party B and the Company (the “SPA”). As an inducement for the Investment, Party A agrees to make available a portion of his personally held shares of Common Stock, in the Company to provide the investment price protection described in this Agreement. Party B acknowledges that other investors signatory to the SPA will be afforded the rights provided for herein. 2. DESIGNATED COLLATERAL SHARES Party A agrees to make available personally held shares of Common Stock of the Company as collateral in support of Party B’s Investment: ● Company: Verde Resources, Inc. ● Ticker Symbol: VRDR ● Investment Amount: $[-] of shares of Common Stock Party A agrees to personally hold and maintain sufficient shares of Common Stock available for the duration of this Agreement to satisfy any potential transfer obligation arising under its terms (the “Collateral Shares”), which Collateral Shares shall remain under Party A’s ownership and control unless and until a transfer is required under this Agreement. No escrow agent, intermediary, or third-party custodian shall be required. 3. SIX-MONTH MARKET VALUE PROTECTION AND SHORTFALL CALCULATION The Parties acknowledge that the Investment is subject to a six (6) month restriction period commencing on __, 2026, and ending on __, 2027 (the “Restriction Period”). For purposes of this Agreement, “Market Value Shortfall” means the difference, if any, between aggregate value of Party B’s original Investment based upon the price per share of Party B’s original Investment amount paid pursuant to the SPA (the “Investor Price”) and the aggregate Market Value of those shares of Common Stock on the Valuation Date, but only if the aggregate Market Value of those shares of Common Stock is less than the original Investor Price. “Market Value” shall be calculated by multiplying the closing price per share of Common Stock on the Company’s principal trading market on the Valuation Date by the number of shares of Common Stock originally acquired through the Investment, adjusted for any stock split or similar corporate action. For purposes of this Agreement, “Valuation Date” means the last day of the Restriction Period, or __, 2027. If a Market Value Shortfall exists, Party A shall transfer such number of Collateral Shares to Party B having an aggregate market value equal to the full dollar amount of the Market Value Shortfall (the “Shortfall Shares”). Example: If Party B makes an Investment of $500,000 and the Market Value of the shares is $400,000 on the Valuation Date, the Market Value Shortfall shall be $100,000. Party A shall therefore transfer such number of Shortfall Shares having an aggregate Market Value of $100,000 to Party B. 4. NO MARKET VALUE SHORTFALL; AUTOMATIC TERMINATION If the aggregate Market Value of the Party B’s shares of Common Stock purchased pursuant to the SPA on the Valuation Date is equal to or greater than the value of Party B’s original Investment amount of $[-], no Market Value Shortfall shall exist, and Party A shall have no obligation to transfer any Shortfall Shares. In such event, this Agreement shall automatically terminate, and any Collateral Shares shall be released from this arrangement, and neither Party shall have any further obligations under this Agreement. 5. REPRESENTATIONS AND OBLIGATIONS Party A represents and agrees that: ● The Collateral Shares are free of any undisclosed liens, pledges, or other encumbrances. ● Sufficient Collateral Shares shall remain available to satisfy any transfer obligation under this Agreement. ● Party A shall not take any action intended to defeat or interfere with the obligations established under this Agreement. ● Party A shall cooperate in good faith and execute all documents reasonably necessary to fulfill the terms of this Agreement. Party B acknowledges that any transfer of Shortfall Shares to Party B remains subject to applicable federal and state securities laws and any applicable transfer restrictions. 6. CERTAIN OTHER MATTERS The Parties acknowledge that under applicable securities laws, this the benefits of this Agreement must be afforded to all investors signature to the SPA. Neither Party shall disclose the terms or existence of this Agreement to any third party without the prior written consent of the other Party, except as required by applicable law, regulation, court order, or in connection with obtaining confidential legal, tax, or financial advice. It is acknowledged that given Party A is an officer and director of the Company, and that the Company will need to publicly disclose the existence and terms of this Agreement in a Form 8-K or other filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. 7. TERM AND TERMINATION This Agreement shall remain in effect throughout the Restriction Period, and, if there is any Market Value Shortfall, until such time as such Market Value Shortfall has been satisfied in accordance with this Agreement. Upon satisfaction of all obligations, this Agreement shall automatically terminate, and any remaining Collateral Shares shall be released from the arrangement and remain the property of Party A. 8. GOVERNING LAW This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Missouri, without regard to its conflict of law principles. 9. ENTIRE AGREEMENT This Agreement represents the entire understanding between the Parties concerning the subject matter herein and supersedes all prior discussions, representations, or understandings relating thereto. Any amendment or modification must be made in writing and signed by both Parties. 10. SIGNATURES IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date. PARTY A – SHAREHOLDER Signature: __________________________________ Printed Name: Date: ______________________________________ PARTY B – INVESTOR Signature: __________________________________ Printed Name: _______________________________ Date: ______________________________________

title: PayPal Holdings, Inc.
text: EX-10.1 2 d196713dex101.htm EX-10.1 EX-10.1 Exhibit 10.1 November 16, 2026 Claire Fullard Dear Claire, We are pleased to offer you the full-time, exempt position of EVP, Chief Financial Officer, currently reporting to PayPal’s President and Chief Executive Officer. This offer letter sets forth the specifics of your job offer and compensation package, including legal terms and conditions. Please review this content and sign where noted, via Docusign. Should you have any questions, please reach out to Isabel Cruz. Your Compensation Package Salary and Bonuses Your annual base salary will be $875,000 (paid bi-weekly at $33,653.84 per pay period, less applicable deductions and tax withholdings). You will be eligible to participate in PayPal’s 2027 Annual Incentive Plan (as may be modified and in effect from time to time, the “AIP”), subject to the terms and conditions of the AIP as determined by the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors of PayPal Holdings, Inc. or its delegate (the “Committee”). The AIP is an incentive bonus that is calculated based on your individual achievement as well as company performance for the applicable year. The AIP performance period is from January 1 through December 31. Your target bonus for the AIP is 125% of your annual base salary, generally pro-rated based on your start date with a PayPal company (“start date”) for your first year of employment (subject to the following paragraph) and days of service in an AIP-eligible position during the AIP performance period. There is no guarantee that any AIP bonus will be awarded or received, and any actual bonus will be determined after the end of the applicable AIP performance period. Any AIP bonus, even if it is made repeatedly or regularly and whatever its amount, can never lead to a vested right for you, the employee. To be eligible to receive any AIP bonus, you must be employed before October 1st of the applicable AIP performance period, and you must remain employed on the date the bonus is paid, subject to applicable laws. If your start date is on or after October 1st, your eligibility to participate in the AIP will begin on January 1 st of the following calendar year. Any bonus or other incentive compensation is at PayPal’s sole and absolute discretion and subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plan document(s). PayPal reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to amend, change or cancel its incentive compensation programs (including the AIP) at any time. Further, the incentive plan that you are eligible to participate in may change over time. You acknowledge and agree that PayPal may substitute the plan referenced in this letter and any contract of employment or any offer documentation, as it determines in its sole discretion from time to time. In addition, PayPal is also offering you the following: • A one-time sign on bonus of $6,000,000 (less applicable deductions and tax withholdings) (the “Sign-On Bonus”). You will be eligible to receive the Sign-On Bonus within the first two payroll periods following your start date, subject to your continued employment on the date of payment. • To be eligible to receive the Sign-On Bonus, you must review and sign the attached standalone Sign-On Bonus Repayment Agreement, which shall govern the terms of the Sign-On Bonus. Equity Grants As a PayPal executive, you will also receive the initial equity grant(s) described below and will be eligible to receive additional annual equity grants beginning in 2028, depending on your performance as assessed by your manager and in all cases subject to approval by the Committee. Equity grants are subject to applicable taxes and withholdings and are governed by the applicable award agreement and any other related documents, the terms and conditions of which will control in the event of any conflict with this offer letter. Grant Value Vesting Schedule Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) USD $6,000,000 The value of the RSUs will be converted into a number of PayPal shares in accordance with PayPal policies. One-third (1/3) of the RSUs subject to the award will vest on the first anniversary of the grant date, with one-twelfth (1/12) of the RSUs subject to the award vesting on each quarterly vest date thereafter, conditioned upon your continued employment with a PayPal company. Supplemental RSUs 12-Month Vesting USD $7,500,000 The value of the RSUs will be converted into a number of PayPal shares in accordance with PayPal policies. These Supplemental RSUs will vest on the one-year anniversary of their grant date, conditioned upon your continued employment with a PayPal company. Supplemental RSUs 24-Month Vesting USD $6,500,000 The value of the RSUs will be converted into a number of PayPal shares in accordance with PayPal policies. These Supplemental RSUs will vest on the two-year anniversary of their grant date, conditioned upon your continued employment with a PayPal company. Performance-Based Restricted Stock Units (PBRSUs) Target value of USD $6,000,000 The target value of the PBRSUs will be converted into a number of PayPal shares in accordance with PayPal policies. Any PBRSUs earned based on PayPal Holdings, Inc.’s performance over the three-year performance period will vest and be settled in March of the year immediately following the end of the performance period, conditioned upon your continued employment with a PayPal company. Please note: The above is only a summary of the RSUs and PBRSUs. Once your equity award(s) are approved and processed (subject to the approval of the Committee or its delegate), the grant date for RSUs and PBRSUs is generally on or around the 15th of the month following the month of your first day of employment, except that if your start date is in January 2027, the grant date for PBRSUs will be March 1, 2027. To be eligible to receive the PBRSUs in the year of your employment start date, you must be employed before December 1st of such year. If your employment start date with a PayPal company commences on or after December 1st, your eligibility to receive the PBRSUs will begin in the year following the year of your employment start date and the grant date of the PBRSUs will be in that year. You will be notified by E*TRADE to set up your account, and will be prompted to accept your grant online. All employees are subject to PayPal’s Insider Trading Policy, which outlines the procedures and guidelines governing securities trades by company personnel. You will be provided with a copy of PayPal’s Insider Trading Policy. Please review the Insider Trading Policy carefully and execute the online certification through our SilkRoad Onboarding Portal to submit it to PayPal’s People team. Benefits You will also receive benefits from PayPal. Please refer to the benefit plan documents for more details, including eligibility. Details about company benefits, which currently include the Employee Stock Purchase Program, 401(k) Plan, and Tracking-Free Vacation, are available here: https://www.paypalbenefits.com/us. Since you will be part of PayPal’s executive team, you’re also eligible to participate in the PayPal Holdings, Inc. Deferred Compensation Plan . The above is just an overview. For more details and plan limitations, please review the applicable Summary Plan Descriptions, plan documents, program summaries or agreements. You’ll see that we’re serious about offering a generous benefits package, though PayPal reserves the right to make changes or cancel any benefits at any time, in PayPal’s sole discretion. Workplace You will be required to work from PayPal’s office located in San Jose, CA. Your role may be performed outside of a PayPal office part of the time with the use of virtual working tools we provide, provided that such virtual working location must be near to the San Jose, CA PayPal office, within the United States. In addition to any in-person working, you may also be required to be present in a PayPal office for in-person collaboration. From time to time, you may be required to work at other locations, as directed by PayPal. We may change the location of your role or remove the ability to work virtually at any time and will give you notice if we do so. Belonging at PayPal PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. Terms and Conditions This offer is contingent upon the results of your background verification and reference checks, as PayPal deems appropriate, in its sole discretion. Please do not hesitate to contact Isabel Cruz if you have any questions pertaining to your background verification or reference checks. Under federal immigration laws, PayPal is required to verify each new employee’s identity and legal authority to work in the United States. Accordingly, please be prepared to furnish appropriate documents satisfying those requirements; this offer of employment is conditioned on submission of satisfactory documentation. You will be provided with a list of the required documents. Your employment at PayPal is at-will and either you or PayPal may terminate your employment at any time, with or without cause or advance notice. The at-will nature of the employment relationship can only be changed by written agreement signed by PayPal’s EVP, Chief People Officer. Other terms, conditions, job responsibilities, compensation and benefits may be adjusted by PayPal from time to time in its sole discretion. Although your employment with PayPal is at-will and either you or PayPal may terminate your employment at any time, with or without cause or advance notice, as a part of PayPal’s executive team, you may be eligible for severance in certain circumstances pursuant and subject to the terms and conditions of any applicable severance program, policy or plan that PayPal may maintain from time to time. If you are subject to a legal hold as of the date your PayPal employment terminates, you must timely provide to PayPal all mobile devices in your possession that may contain relevant data (including but not limited to applicable text messages) for appropriate preservation of such data, upon PayPal’s request. PayPal reserves the right to make changes or cancel any program, policy, plan or benefit at any time, in PayPal’s sole discretion. Kindly indicate your consent to this offer letter by signing and returning a copy through Docusign. In addition to this letter, other important documents, including the Mutual Arbitration Agreement and the Employee Proprietary Information and Inventions Agreement, outline additional terms and conditions of your employment. These documents will be provided to you for signature via our online candidate portal, Workday. Please be sure to thoroughly review these documents prior to signing. These documents must be signed and returned prior to your start date. Upon your signature below, this will become our binding agreement with respect to your employment and its terms, merging and superseding in their entirety all prior written or oral offers, agreements and communications with respect to the terms and conditions of your employment. In accepting this offer and signing below, you acknowledge that you have not relied upon any statement, promise, agreement or representation not set forth in this letter. We respect the privacy of all employees and will comply with all applicable laws regarding processing of personal information. All such personal information is processed in accordance with the PayPal Employee Privacy Statement, a copy of which has been given to you in connection with this offer letter. You acknowledge that you have reviewed and understand the Employee Privacy Statement. At PayPal, we are continuing to write the next chapter in revolutionizing commerce globally. We believe the opportunities ahead of us are greater than ever, and we hope you will join us on the journey. /s/ Isabel Cruz Isabel Cruz EVP, Chief People Officer ACCEPTED: /s/ Claire Fullard Claire Fullard Date: November 16, 2026 Anticipated Start Date (Contingent upon background check): February 1, 2027 Sign-On Bonus Repayment Agreement This Sign-On Bonus Repayment Agreement (“Agreement”) is entered between you and PayPal at the outset of your employment and governs the repayment terms applicable to your discretionary, unearned sign on bonus. PayPal is offering you a sign-on bonus in the amount of $6,000,000 (the “Sign-On Bonus”), less applicable taxes and withholdings. You have two disbursement options as to the Sign-On Bonus. The first option is to have the Sign-On Bonus advanced to you, whereby the Sign-On Bonus will be paid to you within two payroll periods following your start date with PayPal, so long as you have remained continuously employed and in good standing with PayPal through the payment date (the “Advanced Payment Option”). The second option is to have the Sign-On Bonus paid to you in one single payment on the next payroll date following the second anniversary of your start date with PayPal, subject to your continuous employment in good standing with PayPal through that date (the “Deferred Payment Option”). Under the Advanced Payment Option, the Sign-On Bonus is earned over the 24-month period beginning on the payment date (the “Retention Period”), with an equal portion vesting for each day you remain employed and in good standing. If you voluntarily resign or PayPal terminates your employment by reason of your misconduct (or notice is provided related to such voluntary resignation or termination by reason of your misconduct as defined under Section 1256 of the California Unemployment Insurance Code) before the completion of the Retention Period, you will be required to repay to PayPal the unearned portion of the Sign-On Bonus that has been advanced to you. Once you have completed the Retention Period, nothing in this Agreement shall require you to repay any portion of the Sign-On Bonus to PayPal. For the avoidance of doubt, repayment under this Agreement shall not be required if your employment ends due to: termination by PayPal without misconduct; layoff, job elimination, or restructuring; death or disability; or any separation not involving voluntary resignation or termination for misconduct. Any repayment amount owed under this Agreement shall be due within thirty (30) days following your separation of employment. PayPal shall not deduct any repayment amount from final wages unless you provide written authorization at the time of separation, and any such deduction shall comply with applicable California law. You remain responsible for timely repayment of any outstanding balance. Repayment obligations under this Agreement are strictly prorated and shall not include interest, penalties, fees, or any additional amounts beyond the prorated gross installment amount. Under the Deferred Payment Option, the Sign-On Bonus is not earned until the second anniversary of your start date, subject to your continued employment in good standing with PayPal through that date. There is no repayment obligation to PayPal under the Deferred Payment Option. By signing below, you acknowledge that you were notified of your right to consult with an attorney regarding this Agreement and that you were provided at least five (5) business days to review this Agreement before signing and making your election, and if you do not sign and make your election within five (5) business days, PayPal, in its discretion, may withdraw this offer of the Sign-On Bonus to you. You may voluntarily choose to sign this Agreement and make your election before the expiration of the five-business-day review period . You must elect between the Advanced Payment Option and the Deferred Payment Option. Please select one option below: • Advanced Payment Option: __ X ___ I choose to receive the Sign-On Bonus before it is fully earned and understand that any unearned amount may need to be repaid. • Deferred Payment Option: _____ I choose to receive the Sign-On Bonus after completing the Retention Periods and that the bonus will not be paid unless the Retention Periods are completed. This Agreement is intended to comply with California Assembly Bill 692 (Chapter 703) and applicable California Labor Code provisions governing stay-or-pay arrangements. It shall be interpreted consistent with California law and limited to the extent necessary to maintain enforceability. ACCEPTED: /s/ Claire Fullard Claire Fullard Date: November 16, 2026

title: CNL Strategic Capital, LLC
text: EX-10.1 2 ex10-1.htm FIFTH AMENDMENT AND JOINDER TO LOAN AND SECURITY AGREEMENT CNL Strategic Capital, LLC 8-K Exhibit 10.1 Date: as of November 15, 2026 CNL Strategic Capital B, Inc. (on behalf of all Borrowers) CNL Strategic Capital, LLC 450 South Orange Avenue Orlando, FL 32801 Attention: Tammy Tipton Re: Fifth Amendment and Joinder to Loan and Security Agreement Ladies and Gentlemen: We refer to that certain Loan and Security Agreement by and among, CNL Strategic Capital B, Inc., a Delaware Corporation (“ Existing Borrower ”) and CNL Strategic Capital, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (“ Guarantor ” together with Existing Borrower, individually and collectively, as the context requires, but in each case jointly and severally, “ Obligor ” or “ you ”) and Valley National Bank (“ Bank ”, “ we ” or “ us ”) dated February 15, 2024 (as amended, restated, supplemented or otherwise modified, the “ Original Loan Agreement ”). Unless otherwise defined in this amendment letter (the “ Amendment ”), capitalized terms are used as defined in the Original Loan Agreement. You have requested, and Bank has agreed, to (i) add certain co-Borrowers to the Original Loan Agreement, (ii) increase the facilities by converting the existing committed revolving facility to a revolving facility based upon a borrowing base and retaining the existing uncommitted revolving facility, (iii) extend the Revolving Maturity Date and (iv) make such other changes as are set forth below, all on the terms and conditions set forth herein. NOW, THEREFORE , in consideration of the premises set forth herein, and for other good and valuable consideration (the receipt, sufficiency and adequacy of which are hereby acknowledged), the parties hereto (intending to be legally bound) hereby agree as follows: Section 1. Joinder . (a) New Borrowers . Existing Borrower and Guarantor have requested that Bank add the following entities as Borrowers under the Original Loan Agreement and all other Loan Documents (each, and jointly and severally, “ New Borrower ”): (i) [Omitted], (ii) Huron Title Buyer, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, (iii) Vektek Strategic Capital B, Inc., a Delaware corporation, (iv) LBR Strategic Capital B, Inc., a Delaware corporation, (v) USAW Strategic Capital B, Inc., a Delaware corporation, (vi) MAP Strategic Capital B, Inc., a Delaware corporation and (vii) SDC Strategic Capital B, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company. Existing Borrower and Guarantor wish to add New Borrower as a party to the Loan Documents in order to facilitate its ability to continue to operate its business by achieving a stronger financial base for itself and its affiliated companies. (b) Effectiveness . From and after the date hereof (the “ Effective Date ”), New Borrower, Existing Borrower, Guarantor and Bank desire to supplement the terms and provisions of the Original Loan Agreement as provided herein, and the Original Loan Agreement as supplemented by this Amendment, and as may be hereafter further supplemented, amended, modified or restated from time to time, shall be referred to collectively as the “ Loan Agreement .” Bank desires that New Borrower execute this Amendment and joinder for the purpose of acknowledging that it is and shall be a Borrower under the Loan Agreement and the other Loan Documents. (c) Joinder and Assumption . From and after the Effective Date, New Borrower hereby absolutely and unconditionally: (i) (A) joins as and becomes a party to the Loan Agreement as a Borrower thereunder, (B) assumes, as a joint and several obligor thereunder, all of the obligations, liabilities and indemnities of a Borrower under the Loan Agreement and all other Loan Documents, and (C) covenants and agrees to be bound by and adhere to all of the terms, covenants, waivers, releases, agreements and conditions of or respecting a Borrower with respect to the Loan Agreement and the other Loan Documents and all of the representations and warranties contained in the Loan Agreement (in the manner set forth in Section 4 of this Amendment) and the other Loan Documents with respect to New Borrower; and VNB/CNL Strategic Capital B – Fifth Amendment and Joinder (ii) collaterally assigns and transfers to Bank, and hereby grants to Bank, a continuing security interest in all of such New Borrower’s now owned and existing and hereafter acquired and arising assets and Collateral, as collateral security for the prompt and complete payment and performance when due (whether at the stated maturity, by acceleration or otherwise) of all of the Obligations. New Borrower hereby authorizes Bank to file at any time uniform commercial code financing statements in such jurisdictions and offices as Bank deems necessary in connection with the perfection of a security interest in all of such New Borrower’s now owned or hereafter arising or acquired assets and property, including, without limitation, accounts receivable, deposit accounts, equipment, general intangibles, inventory, and any and all other personal property of such New Borrower, and all products, substitutions, replacements, and proceeds of such property and assets. New Borrower has read the Loan Agreement and affirmatively grants to Bank all rights to New Borrower’s assets as set forth in said Loan Agreement and the Loan Documents as amended by this Amendment. From and after the Effective Date, any reference to the term “Borrower” in the Loan Agreement shall include Existing Borrower and also include New Borrower. Except as expressly provided herein, the Loan Agreement remains in full force and effect and is hereby ratified and confirmed in all respects. Section 2. Amendments . (a) Added Definitions . The following terms are hereby added to Section 1.1 of the Loan Agreement, in alphabetical order, and shall read as follows: “Annual Pro Forma Debt Service Coverage Ratio” means, as of any given date, the ratio of (a) net investment income on a trailing twelve months basis to (b) pro forma annual principal amortization plus cash interest due on all outstanding Obligations under the Committed Revolving Line. For purposes of the foregoing, “pro forma annual principal amortization” means the five (5) year amortization burden assuming the amount outstanding under the Committed Revolving Line. “ Borrowing Base ” means twenty percent (20%) of Guarantor’s Eligible Portfolio Net Asset Value. “Committed Revolving Facility” means the facility under which Borrower may request Bank to issue Advances, as specified in Section 2.1.1 hereof. “Committed Revolving Line” means committed Credit Extensions under Section 2.1.1(a) of the Loan Agreement in an aggregate amount not to exceed at any one time outstanding Fifty Million Dollars ($50,000,000) (the “Maximum Committed Credit Limit”). Borrower, on behalf of Guarantor, may request Credit Extensions under the Committed Revolving Line to finance the redemption, repurchase or buyback of Guarantor’s equity securities from its equity holders (each such Credit Extension, a “ Redemption Advance ”). Each Redemption Advance shall accrue interest at the rate provided for in Section 2.2(a)(i) hereof and shall be payable as provided for in Section 2.2(c) hereof. Each Redemption Advance shall be due on the Committed Revolving Maturity Date. “Committed Revolving Maturity Date” means November 15, 2029. “Eligible Portfolio Net Asset Value” means the net asset value of Guarantor’s total Eligible Investments (as determined in accordance with each Guarantor’s valuation policy). 2 “Fifth Amendment” means that certain Fifth Amendment and Joinder to Loan and Security Agreement dated November 15, 2026 by and between Obligor and Bank. “Fourth Amendment” means that certain Fourth Amendment to Loan and Security Agreement letter agreement dated August 10, 2026 by and between Obligor and Bank. “ Letter of Credit Exposure ” means, as of any date of determination, the sum, without duplication, of (a) the aggregate undrawn amount of all outstanding Letters of Credit and any obligations of Bank related to purchased participations or indemnity or reimbursement obligations with respect to Letters of Credit, plus (b) the aggregate unreimbursed amount of all drawn Letters of Credit until such amount becomes an Advance under the Committed Revolving Line under the terms of this Agreement. “Maximum Committed Credit Limit” has the meaning ascribed to it in the definition of Committed Revolving Line. “Maximum Credit Limit” means One Hundred Million Dollars ($100,000,000) comprised of Credit Extensions, in the aggregate, under the Committed Revolving Line and the Uncommitted Revolving Line. “Maximum Uncommitted Credit Limit” has the meaning ascribed to it in the definition of Uncommitted Revolving Line. “Term Loan” or “Term Loans” means a converted Advance or Advances under the Committed Revolving Facility into one or more Term Loans under Section 2.1.1(b). “Term Maturity Date” means, with respect to each Term Loan, the date that is five (5) years from the applicable conversion date to such Term Loan. The Term Maturity Date of an applicable Term Loan may surpass the Committed Revolving Maturity Date assuming there is no Event of Default. “Trailing Twelve Month Debt Service Coverage Ratio” means, as of any given date, the ratio of (a) net investment income on a trailing twelve month basis to (b) scheduled annual principal amortization plus cash interest due on all outstanding Obligations under the Committed Revolving Line. “Uncommitted Revolving Facility” means the facility under which Borrower may request Bank to issue Advances, as specified in Section 2.1.2 hereof. “Uncommitted Revolving Line” means discretionary Credit Extensions under Section 2.1.2(a) of the Loan Agreement in an aggregate amount not to exceed at any one time outstanding Fifty Million Dollars ($50,000,000) (the “Maximum Uncommitted Credit Limit”). Bank’s determination, if at all, to approve a Credit Extension request under the Uncommitted Revolving Line shall be based upon the terms and conditions provided for in the Borrowing Request Procedure set forth in Section 2.1.2(b) of this Agreement. Bank and Borrower intend, acknowledge and agree that the Uncommitted Revolving Line is unconditionally cancellable at Bank’s option, and Bank shall have the right to cancel all unused availability and refuse to extend available credit under the Uncommitted Revolving Line, at any time and from time to time, without prior notice to Borrower and for any reason, or no reason at all, in its sole and absolute discretion. “Uncommitted Revolving Maturity Date” means November 15, 2029, unless extended, at Bank’s sole option, one additional year, in which instance the Uncommitted Revolving Maturity Date shall be such extended date. 3 (b) Modified Definitions . The following terms set forth Section 1.1 of the Loan Agreement are hereby modified to read as follows: “Advance” or “Advances” means a cash advance or cash advances under the Committed Revolving Facility or Uncommitted Revolving Facility, as applicable. “ Portfolio Company(ies) ” means a company which Guarantor previously identified as a Target Acquisition Company for equity in or loans to such company, whether prior to or after the date of this Agreement, and which Credit Party acquired an interest in or extended a loan thereto, all in connection with Guarantor’s business. “ Revolving Line ” means the Committed Revolving Line and the Uncommitted Revolving Line. “ Revolving Line Maturity Date ” [Omitted]. (c) Modified Credit Extensions . Section 2.1 of the Loan Agreement is hereby amended and restated in its entirety to read as follows: 2.1 Credit Extensions. At the time Borrower requests an Advance, Borrower will elect whether the Advance will be requested under the Committed Revolving Line or requested under the Uncommitted Revolving Line. While Advances under the Committed Revolving Line may be converted to Term Loans pursuant to Section 2.1.1(b) below, Advances under the Committed Revolving Line cannot be recharacterized as Advances under the Uncommitted Revolving Line, and Advances under the Uncommitted Revolving Line cannot be recharacterized as Advances under the Committed Revolving Line. 2.1.1 Committed Credit Extensions. (a) Committed Revolving Line . Subject to the terms and conditions of Section 3.2 of this Agreement, Bank shall, at the request of Borrower, make Advances in an aggregate outstanding amount not to exceed the lesser of (A) the Maximum Committed Credit Limit and (B) the Borrowing Base, minus , in each case, the Letter of Credit Exposure. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, Advances may be repaid and reborrowed at any time prior to the Committed Revolving Maturity Date. As a point of clarification, Section 12.14 shall not apply to this Section 2.1.1(a). (i) Form of Request . Tipton Title: Chief Financial Officer VNB/CNL Strategic Capital B – Fifth Amendment and Joinder 14 EXHIBIT A The Collateral consists of all of the following, whether now owned or hereafter acquired or arising and wherever located: all of Credit Party’s present and future right, title and interests in, to and under: (a) all accounts, goods (including, without limitation, equipment, machinery and furniture), chattel paper (tangible or electronic), inventory, general intangibles of every kind and nature (including intellectual property), instruments, documents, letters of credit and letter-of-credit rights, supporting obligations, commercial tort claims, property now or hereafter in Bank’s control or possession; (b) all equity interests of Credit Party in its Portfolio Companies; (c) all investment property (including, without limitation, securities entitlements, securities accounts, commodity accounts and commodity contracts); (d) all intercompany receivables; (e) any and all capital raised from investors for the benefit of Credit Party including, without limitation, all Subscription Agreement Funds; (f) any subscription agreement or similar agreement related thereto; (g) all dividends, distributions, liquidations, and any other payments to or for the benefit of Credit Party as a result of investments and loans in Portfolio Companies or the sale of Credit Party’s interest therein; (h) all deposit accounts (as defined in the Uniform Commercial Code), and all bank and deposit accounts (whether a deposit account, money market account, certificate of deposit or other account), including all deposit accounts into which the funds from such capital raises are, have been or may be deposited including, without limitation, the Pledged Account, and all bank and deposit accounts (whether a deposit account, money market account, certificate of deposit or other account), including all deposit accounts into which the funds from such dividends, distributions, liquidations or other payments identified in subclause (g) above are, have been or may be deposited including, without limitation, the Pledged Account; (i) all of Credit Party’s Books relating to the foregoing; and (j) all property related to the foregoing and any and all claims, rights and interests in any of the above and all substitutions for, additions and accessions to and proceeds thereof. Each Credit Party hereby covenants and agrees that it shall not create, assume, incur, or permit or suffer to exist any mortgage, pledge, encumbrance, charge or other lien upon, or security interest in, all or any portion of the Collateral (other than Permitted Liens). 15
